title: 2 a.m. buzzing and knocks in Florida home

tellings.quote: years later then I'm in I'm at home. I'm in Florida now. And uh 2:00 in the morning, something like that.

plain: Late one night, at about 2 a.m. in his Florida home, the writer Peter Levenda says he heard buzzing and knocking that he could not explain. He tells Michels this happened to him first-hand, years after an earlier experience. While telling it, he brings up Whitley Strieber, an author known for describing his own encounters with otherworldly visitors, as a point of comparison.
